interpro_id.description: InterPro family/domain accession in IPRNNNNNN format. Selects the InterPro entry whose member UniProt sequences are returned. Use literature_search to discover the right InterPro ID for a keyword.

max_sequences.description: Maximum number of UniProt sequences to return from this InterPro entry.

reviewed.description: If true, restrict to Swiss-Prot (reviewed) entries; if false, restrict to TrEMBL. Null returns both.

taxon_id.description: NCBI taxonomy id to restrict results to a clade. Null disables taxonomy filtering.

min_length.description: Optional minimum sequence length (inclusive) in amino acids.

max_length.description: Optional maximum sequence length (inclusive) in amino acids.

temporal_cutoff.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); only sequences with UniProt entry dates on/before this date are returned, for reproducing historic snapshots.

include_fragments.description: If true, include sequences flagged by UniProt as `Fragment` (incomplete N- or C-terminus). Default excludes them.

include_undated.description: When `temporal_cutoff` is set, controls whether records without a parseable entry date are included.

deduplicate_sequences.description: Drop duplicate sequence strings across accessions so each returned sequence is unique.

page_size.description: Number of records fetched per InterPro/UniProt API page.

max_scan_accessions.description: Upper bound on accessions scanned during the InterPro traversal. Null means no cap.
